items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I understand there could have been some others that I don’t know their playing or I don’t know who started first, but Waymon Carver and some other people.

ctx.x: You’re right. There seems to be a little bit of controversy, but you hear different stories of who actually was the first jazz flute player. Your name always comes up.
Yeah my name seems to come up. I understand there could have been some others that I don’t know their playing or I don’t know who started first, but Waymon Carver and some other people.
I think it’s more — they maybe just used it incidentally. So who was the first person to really—
